steps.description: Implement a controlled numerical experiment to test the geometric hypothesis on solution-space rigidity using small feedforward networks. The script will: (1) Define a constraint function f(x) with known analytic properties; (2) Generate w training samples; (3) Train networks with varying hidden widths N; (4) Measure max absolute error on a held-out validation set; (5) Determine N_c(w) as the minimal width achieving zero violation (error ≤ 1e-3). The experiment will sweep w from 5 to 50 and N from 2 to 100, logging training/validation errors and N_c values. Results will be analyzed for rigidity (finite N_c constant in w) vs. fatness (N_c diverges or is unattainable).
